evidence: Agent image: task/environment/Dockerfile (sha256 0a75419e...67d1) is byte-identical to the frozen template rules/projects/webdev-task-template/environment/Dockerfile (diff: no output). It COPYs only instructions/ -> /instructions and assets/ -> /assets, then creates /app with git init and a single committed /app/.gitkeep; no COPY of solution/ or tests/, no starter. task.toml has no [environment].docker_image (no prebuilt image that could carry extra content); artifacts = ['/app','/assets']. environment/ contains exactly three non-Dockerfile files: assets/seed_data.json (sha256 a1c65c80...3740), instructions/hireops_rules.md (23ba10bf...c012), instructions/integration.md (4eddd8a3...b9). seed_data.json is pure input data: keys generated_note, stages, candidate_status_labels, thread_page_size, users(10: id,name,email,role), jobs(3), applications(16: id,job_id,candidate_name,candidate_email,source,stage,position[,rejected_from,reject_reason]), messages(127: 120 on APP-101, 3+3+1 elsewhere, generic bodies), notes(3), reads(6: read_count). No derived/expected outputs (no computed unread counts, versions, activity lines, seen states, API shapes or schema), no HTML/JS/UI, no grader content. hireops_rules.md is a requester-voice operating note; line 3-5 says 'Routes, field names, element ids, button labels and the shape of the pages are up to you'. It gives behaviour rules and status codes (401/403/404/409, lines 22-24, 79) but no route list, schema, skeleton or code. integration.md is the runtime contract (server.js, port, DB_PATH, NODE_PATH, health), with 'How routes and files are laid out under /app is up to you' (line 14). Rubric non-reproduction: grep of environment/ for criterion|rubric|judge|grader|expected|hro_|sentinel|weight|score|test|http found only innocuous 'answer'/'answers' prose; an n-gram comparison of hireops_rules.md, integration.md and instruction.md against every tests/**/*.toml and *.md found zero shared 8-word sequences and only seven 6-word phrases, all with hireops_rules.md vs tests/scored/functional/judge.toml and all short requirement restatements ('says the card was changed and', 'the box is empty and still', 'its most recent 30 messages oldest', 'most recent 30 messages oldest of', '30 at a time in order', 'how many are still to come', 'other candidates or their applications or'). No criterion ids, steps, seeded expected readings or weights appear in /instructions. Lessons file checked for patterns bearing on this row: #1/#12 (hidden or checklist-style notes that tell the builder how to build for the grader) - the notes keep requester reasons and do not mirror criteria verbatim (the overlap scan above); whether their style is too checklist-like belongs to rows 1-3, not to an answer leak. #13 (public internet address) - no http/https URL appears in environment/ or the brief. Other lessons concern judge prompts, timing, restart, weights and process, so they do not bear on the agent's environment. Adversarial: broken app that could pass because of a leak - none is possible, because the image holds no finished or partial deliverable to copy and the seed carries no expected outputs that could be echoed to fake a criterion (criteria require live server-backed behaviour). Conforming alternative that could fail because of the environment - none found: the notes explicitly leave routes, ids, labels and layout to the builder. No Docker build was run (none needed: static bytes match the template and the review is read-only); the run_verdict is NOT EXERCISED for runtime, but this row is fully decidable from the frozen bytes.
